name: Vanilla bean, cured (Bourbon-style, ~35% moisture)
source: Fully cured (blanched, sweated, sun-dried, conditioned) bean: illustrative proximate (per kg) water 350 g (~35%, typical high-grade Bourbon-cured vanilla), protein 60 g, fat 60 g, carbohydrate 470 g, ash 60 g — cured vanilla retains substantially more moisture than most dried spices (curing chemistry literature).
notes: Standard elemental conversion factors as wheat-grain.json. Vanillin and the bean's other aromatic phenolics are a small mass fraction (typically ~2% of cured bean weight) of the whole bean and are folded into the generic carbohydrate-like bucket here rather than modelled by their own distinct aromatic C:H:O ratio — a stated simplification given their small share of total mass.
